fields.protocol.title: A Phase 1 Study of RNV-220 in Healthy Adult Volunteers

fields.plan.rationale: RNV-220 is an inhaled agent intended to provide once-daily control of moderate persistent asthma with lower systemic exposure than currently available oral therapy. Nonclinical inhalation toxicology supports evaluation in humans at the proposed doses.
fields.plan.general_approach: A first-in-human study in healthy adult volunteers will establish safety, tolerability and systemic exposure following single and repeat inhaled doses before any study is conducted in participants with asthma.
fields.plan.first_year_scope: One Phase 1 single- and multiple-ascending-dose study in healthy adult volunteers is planned in the first year. A patient study is contemplated thereafter but its protocol has not been developed.
fields.plan.estimated_enrollment: Approximately 48 healthy adult volunteers across all dose cohorts.
fields.plan.anticipated_risks: Anticipated risks of particular severity are bronchospasm following inhaled administration and, at the highest planned doses, the systemic corticosteroid-like effects seen in 13-week dog inhalation toxicology. Spirometry is performed before and after each dose, and rescue medication is available at the site.

planned_studies.title: A Phase 1 Study of RNV-220 in Healthy Adult Volunteers
planned_studies.objectives: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of single and multiple ascending inhaled doses of RNV-220 and to characterise systemic pharmacokinetics.
planned_studies.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, single- and multiple-ascending-dose study.
planned_studies.sample_size: Approximately 48 participants, 8 per cohort randomised 6:2 active to placebo.
planned_studies.population: Healthy adults aged 18 to 55 with normal spirometry and no history of reactive airway disease.
planned_studies.parameters: Adverse events, spirometry, vital signs, ECG, clinical laboratory tests, and plasma pharmacokinetics.
planned_studies.status: Protocol submitted with this Initial IND. Enrolment has not started.

notes: Clean case with inhaled dosage form.
